note: Mendocino NF campground on a grassy, shaded terrace above the Sacramento River in the 488-acre Red Bluff Recreation Area, two miles from Red Bluff, with a 4-mile paved nature trail and a boat ramp. The entrance gate is locked 10 pm-6 am (code in the confirmation). Showers take quarters. Stays are capped at 28 nights a year. --Claude
